hadith:
Laws of Inheritance (Al-Faraa'id) - Narrated Sa`d:

I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever claims to be the son of a person other than his father, and he knows that person is not his father, then Paradise will be forbidden for him." I mentioned that to Abu Bakra, and he said, "My ears heard that and my heart memorized it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
message: Remembering our blessings and expressing gratitude can lead us closer to divine reward. Just as Moses recognized the significance of small details, let us appreciate every moment and effort in our lives. By acknowledging Allah's grace through sincere thanks, we open ourselves to greater blessings and fulfillment.
name:
Ash Shakoor - الشَّكُورُ - The Rewarder of Thankfulness

The term 'Ash Shakoor' originates from Arabic, where 'Shakoor' refers to being grateful or appreciative. This name reflects Allah's nature of valuing and rewarding the efforts and sincerity of His worshippers, even if their deeds may seem minor. It emphasizes the importance of gratitude and acknowledgment, encouraging believers to perform good deeds with the understanding that Allah appreciates their efforts.
verse:
Al-Kahf - The Cave - 18:63-64

He replied, “Do you remember when we rested by the rock? ˹That is when˺ I forgot the fish. None made me forget to mention this except Satan. And the fish made its way into the sea miraculously.”

Moses responded, “That is ˹exactly˺ what we were looking for.” So they returned, retracing their footsteps.
